query: insert into lms_course_sync (id, course_id, lms_provider, external_course_id, api_endpoint, last_synced_at) values ($1, $2, 'canvas', $3, $4, $5) on conflict (course_id, lms_provider) do update set external_course_id = excluded.external_course_id, api_endpoint = excluded.api_endpoint, last_synced_at = excluded.last_synced_at
